tagline: Fourteen islands stitched by 57 bridges — a medieval old town, a salvaged 17th-century warship, and Scandinavia's design capital.
overview: Stockholm spreads across 14 islands where Lake Mälaren meets the Baltic, stitched together by 57 bridges. Water is everywhere — locals swim off the city quays and take ferries like buses.

Gamla Stan, the medieval old town, hides 13th-century lanes beneath golden gables, while Djurgården island holds the big museums: the Vasa warship (salvaged 333 years after sinking on its maiden voyage), ABBA The Museum, and the open-air Skansen.
Speed's 2024 tour streamed from Stockholm — the Swedish crowds were among the trip's most energetic. Beyond the centre, the archipelago's 30,000 islands stretch to the horizon by boat.
